Thanks again for taking the time today - really useful conversation. Recap and next steps below so we stay aligned on the security/compliance items you flagged for a private deployment (VPC/on-prem):

Call recap:
- Acme is evaluating a private/VPC deployment for PHI workloads (HIPAA scope) and has GDPR considerations for EU customers.
- Primary ask: network isolation, KMS options, SOC 2 status, and a vendor security questionnaire (SSQ) to start the procurement process.

Attachments included: redwood_private_deployment_diagram_v2.pdf, vendor_ssq_template.xlsx (quick reference).

Key notes to help with the SSQ:
- SOC 2: Redwood maintains SOC 2 Type II for our hosted environment; we can provide a summarized report and scope details for private deployments - Marcus will confirm exact coverage and timelines.
- Encryption: We support customer-managed KMS for encryption at rest (AWS KMS / Azure Key Vault / GCP CMEK) for VPC and offer HSM integrations for Private/On-Prem.
- Network isolation: Private VPC option can be configured with no public IPs, managed NAT gateways for controlled egress, and restricted peering; on-prem/air-gapped options require an appliance image and manual onboarding.

Would love the completed SSQ by EOD Friday (5/17) if possible so we can scope the SOW and schedule a technical deep dive.

Thanks - Marissa

Marissa / Laura,

Thanks - quick answers inline and attachments included (SOC2_report_summary.pdf, redwood_private_deployment_diagram_v2.pdf). I'll also update the SSQ spreadsheet with the detailed responses and return it to Marissa for review.

Inline answers:
- KMS / key isolation: Yes. For VPC and Private deployments we support customer-managed keys via AWS KMS/Azure Key Vault/GCP CMEK. Keys can be configured such that only the data plane has decrypt/encrypt permissions; control plane access is restricted by IAM policies and we offer optional HSM-backed key storage for additional isolation. We will include recommended IAM policy examples in the updated SSQ.

- On-prem / air-gapped update process: We provide a signed appliance image for air-gapped installs and an offline patch bundle. Update process is:
  1) Customer downloads signed update bundle from a secure portal (with SSO) on a staging host.
  2) Operations performs signature verification and transfers via removable media to the air-gapped environment.
  3) Appliance performs local verify/install and reports status to an offline audit log.
  4) For environments requiring vendor-assisted updates, we offer a professional services package to manage patch delivery.

- SOC 2 status: Redwood has a SOC 2 Type II report covering our hosted control plane and managed data plane as of 2027-11 (summary attached). For private/on-prem customers, control plane responsibilities shift and we provide a scoped attestation and supporting evidence (logs, change control, encryption configuration) as part of onboarding. Marcus to follow up with the exact list of artifacts we can provide to Acme (audit logs, architecture diagrams, control mappings).

- Network isolation / deployment notes (high level):
  - VPC: Dedicated subnets for data plane, no public IPs, transit gateway peering for customer network, strict security groups, and egress filtering.
  - On-prem: Option for fully air-gapped deployment with no egress; use of HSM or KMS proxy appliance for key operations.
  - Data residency: we can deploy in a customer-controlled VPC in their cloud account (preferred for GDPR/EEA data residency).

Action items:
- I will populate the SSQ with exact control references and attach the updated spreadsheet by EOD.
- Marissa: propose deep-dive times (Tue/Wed) and I'll be available for the technical session.

Regards,
Marcus

Attachments: SOC2_report_summary.pdf; redwood_private_deployment_diagram_v2.pdf
